coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of the 8 ground-truth variable items (25%): both query directions and retrieval accuracy measured through correct answers and log-probabilities.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the fixed IMDb/GPT-4 dataset with Wikidata/Wikipedia cohorts and substitutes a different model suite. Uses fixed temperature 0 rather than model-dependent settings. Does not specify controlled chat-based versus completion-based interaction modes or the same dataset-creation, testing, and visualization scripts. Uses McNemar’s test and regression instead of the specified t-tests and Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to provide the expected finding of higher child-to-parent retrieval performance and significantly lower parent-to-child performance, confirming the reversal curse.
